name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: RadioGroup / RadioGroupItem (@didact/ui, layers 1-2): a single-select group of radio controls backed by the unified radix-ui package's RadioGroup, which owns the roving-tabindex keyboard behavior and aria-checked/data-state for each item. The selected-state indicator is an inline SVG circle rather than an icon-library import -- see packages/ui/src/components/radio-group.tsx.
